name: Mega-class Star Dreadnought
description: The Mega-class Star Dreadnought, also known as the Mega-class Star Destroyer, the Mega Star Destroyer, or the First Order Mega-Destroyer, was a class of Star Dreadnought utilized by the First Order during their conflict with the Resistance. It was believed to be the largest ship ever constructed in galactic history.
